name: Baked Lay's Original Potato Crisps (Lower Fat Option)
whyItWorks: Baked instead of deep-fried, Baked Lay's contain 65% less fat than traditional potato chips (only 3g fat per serving). They provide crispy salty gratification without triggering fat-induced diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A great alternative to standard fried potato chips. Pair with a turkey breast sandwich or eat as an afternoon snack.
watchOuts: Chew each crisp well to avoid swallowing sharp unchewed corners.
